definition: An individual or organisation that holds or applies for a contractual relationship with HelvetiaCare.
The unique enterprise identifier assigned to a customer record.
The official first name and surname of an individual customer or the registered name of an organisation.
The officially recorded date on which an individual customer was born.
The current registered residential address of an individual customer.
The address approved for sending communications to a customer.
The current approved status of a customer consent record for a defined processing purpose.
The date from which a recorded customer consent or withdrawal becomes effective.
A formal insurance contract defining coverage between HelvetiaCare and a policyholder.
The unique identifier assigned to an insurance policy.
The individual or organisation legally responsible for an insurance policy.
The customer identifier linking an insurance policy to its policyholder.
The date on which insurance coverage under a policy begins.
The date on which an insurance policy or its coverage ends.
The current approved lifecycle state of an insurance policy.
The approved category of insurance protection attached to a policy.
The period during which defined insurance coverage is effective.
related_terms: Policy Inception Date; Policy Expiry Date

definition: A request for assessment and reimbursement under an insurance policy.
The unique identifier assigned to an insurance claim.
The date on which HelvetiaCare receives an insurance claim.
The date on which a healthcare service related to a claim was provided.
The monetary amount submitted for reimbursement within a claim.
The amount approved for payment after assessment of an insurance claim.
The current approved lifecycle state of an insurance claim.
A healthcare professional or organisation delivering services relevant to insurance administration or reimbursement.
The unique enterprise identifier assigned to a healthcare provider.
The officially registered name of a healthcare professional or organisation.
The approved classification of a healthcare professional or organisation.
The current verified professional or institutional licence state of a healthcare provider.
The current lifecycle state of the commercial relationship with a healthcare provider.
The approved account identifier used to process payments to a healthcare provider.
A recorded financial event affecting the accounts of HelvetiaCare.
The unique identifier assigned to a financial transaction.
The date on which a financial transaction is recognised in the accounts.
The monetary value recorded for a financial transaction.
The approved ISO currency code associated with a financial transaction.
The approved account used to classify a financial transaction within the general ledger.
The current approved lifecycle state of an incoming or outgoing payment.
The approved accounting period to which a financial transaction is assigned.
A data element whose failure could materially affect customers, operations, reporting, compliance or decision-making.
The senior business role accountable for data within an assigned enterprise data domain.
The role responsible for coordinating the operational implementation of Data Governance within a data domain.
The role responsible for implementing and operating technical controls for systems and data platforms.
A documented condition in which data fails to meet an approved business or quality requirement.
An approved and measurable condition used to determine whether data meets a defined quality requirement.
